json_profile.numbers: base-10 integers only; no leading zero; arbitrary precision
json_profile.object_keys: Unicode scalar strings; typed record field names are ASCII
json_profile.string_escaping: JSON with every non-ASCII code point escaped
json_profile.strings: Unicode scalar strings only; lone surrogate code points rejected

typed_values.enum: JSON string equal to the declared enum value
typed_values.tuple: JSON array preserving source tuple order
